snippet.title: Warpath Launch Trailer | Halo Infinite
snippet.description:
Harken ye to the drums of war. Operation: Warpath sallies forth!

Embark on a righteous crusade to claim myth-made armor sets, clash with ever-stronger foes in the epic Invasion mode, and forge new annals in Halo history 'pon the storied terrains of Ranked Legacy.

Conquer the latest free, 20-tier Operation Pass before October 7 to gird your loins in the new Lancer armor set and the UEG Regalia parade coating. 

Upgrade to the Premium Pass to ride into battle with the Ornamented VK78 Commando weapon model and the exclusive Fused Suns weapon coating.

Have at thee, knave! Operation: Warpath awaits its champions.

Read more at aka.ms/WarpathLaunch ⚔️
